name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including its private notes. The header reserves a non-shrinking actions column from 1024 px and moves the actions below the title at 412×915 and 835×1195; a long legal title is capped at two lines with its complete value available in the title attribute, while status stays fixed and a long client name truncates independently. The document-level Acciones menu is visually separated from the Cancelar/Guardar edit pair, and none of those controls wraps. The compact doc-client-note-open entry opens a modal prefilled with email subject, email body, WhatsApp, and ordered custom title/content notes; applying changes participates in the unsaved guard, and save persists the complete collection. Failed or rejected saves retain the notes draft, while issued collection accounts expose it read-only. The existing content/status, client/project association, backlinks, Markdown clipboard toolbar, template-style preview, and dual PDF download remain available.
